title: The draft-PR guard skips PR-create words that sit inside a heredoc or string
why: Incident, triage 2026-11-07 about 14:52 CST: rule draft-pr refused a Bash call because the words of a PR-create command sat inside a Python heredoc string (roadmap step text), not a real command.
note: Coordinator 14:53 CST: a fix, not a note. Red case first: a heredoc that holds the words passes, a real PR create with no draft flag still refuses. Guard change, full review rounds. Cause (lane, about 14:55 CST): strip_heredoc_bodies in hooks/guard_core.py, the one heredoc home, keeps every heredoc body in view when any heredoc-written file is run in the same command, so a data body is read as shell. The fix narrows that home, so it touches every rule that reads heredocs, not draft-pr alone. Topic guard-false-alarms.
